headline_marked: Police officer [[finds 10-year-old son dead]] at accident scene
headline: Police officer finds 10-year-old son dead at accident scene
summary: A police constable in Kishoreganj rushed to a road accident site as part of his duty, only to discover the victim was his own child.
details: A police constable who responded to a road accident in Kishoreganj this morning discovered that the victim was his 10-year-old son, Mohammad Tuhin.
Tuhin, a class-4 student of Gaital Janata School, was killed instantly after being run over by a cement-carrying truck on Janata School Road around 10:30 am.
Constable Shamsul Haque, who serves at the Kishoreganj Sadar Model Police Station, was driving the patrol vehicle when the team was dispatched to the scene.
The police station had received a report of a school student's death, but the identity of the child was not known to the officers at the time of the dispatch.
Locals reported that Tuhin had left home in the Gaital area on his bicycle and was riding along the road when the truck hit him.
Officer-in-Charge Mohammad Abul Kalam Bhuiyan stated that the body was recovered and sent to the hospital morgue for an autopsy.
caption:
A father's worst nightmare: a police officer responds to an accident call and finds his own son dead on the road.

A police constable who responded to a road accident in Kishoreganj this morning discovered that the victim was his 10-year-old son, Mohammad Tuhin.

Tuhin, a class-4 student of Gaital Janata School, was killed instantly after being run over by a cement-carrying truck on Janata School Road around 10:30 am.

Constable Shamsul Haque, who serves at the Kishoreganj Sadar Model Police Station, was driving the patrol vehicle when the team was dispatched to the scene.

The police station had received a report of a school student's death, but the identity of the child was not known to the officers at the time of the dispatch.

Locals reported that Tuhin had left home in the Gaital area on his bicycle and was riding along the road when the truck hit him.

Officer-in-Charge Mohammad Abul Kalam Bhuiyan stated that the body was recovered and sent to the hospital morgue for an autopsy.

headline_marked: Germany appoint [[Juergen Klopp as head coach]] on four-year deal
headline: Germany appoint Juergen Klopp as head coach on four-year deal
summary: The former Liverpool and Borussia Dortmund manager takes over following Germany's disappointing World Cup campaign.
details: Germany have appointed Juergen Klopp as head coach on a four-year contract to lead the national team into a new era. He replaces Julian Nagelsmann, who left the role after a penalty shootout defeat by Paraguay in the round of 32.
Klopp, previously Red Bull's global head of soccer, stated that the national team can connect Germans like hardly anything else and expressed his desire to develop a team that fights for each other.

He will be supported by assistants Peter Krawietz, Pep Lijnders, and former international Sven Bender. Additionally, Per Mertesacker has been appointed as managing director for sport through to the 2030 World Cup.
DFB president Bernd Neuendorf described Klopp as the federation's ideal solution from the start, noting that discussions strengthened the belief he is the right man for the job.
To facilitate the move, Red Bull agreed to release Klopp, and the DFB will donate ‘’1 million to Red Bull's Wings for Life foundation instead of paying compensation.
Klopp brings a wealth of experience, having won Bundesliga and German Cup titles with Borussia Dortmund and leading Liverpool to Champions League and Premier League glory over nine years.
caption:
Juergen Klopp is back in the dugout! The legendary manager takes the helm of the German national team.

Germany have appointed Juergen Klopp as head coach on a four-year contract to lead the national team into a new era. He replaces Julian Nagelsmann, who left the role after a penalty shootout defeat by Paraguay in the round of 32.

Klopp, previously Red Bull's global head of soccer, stated that the national team can connect Germans like hardly anything else and expressed his desire to develop a team that fights for each other.

He will be supported by assistants Peter Krawietz, Pep Lijnders, and former international Sven Bender. Additionally, Per Mertesacker has been appointed as managing director for sport through to the 2030 World Cup.

DFB president Bernd Neuendorf described Klopp as the federation's ideal solution from the start, noting that discussions strengthened the belief he is the right man for the job.

To facilitate the move, Red Bull agreed to release Klopp, and the DFB will donate ‘’1 million to Red Bull's Wings for Life foundation instead of paying compensation.

Klopp brings a wealth of experience, having won Bundesliga and German Cup titles with Borussia Dortmund and leading Liverpool to Champions League and Premier League glory over nine years.
